title: Back 2 Base - In the Name of Love (Bonkerz Remix Edit) (2016)

lines.l: If I told you we could bathe in all the lights
Would you rise up, come and meet me in the sky?
Would you trust me when you're jumping from the heights?
Would you fall in the name of love?
When there's madness, when there's poison in your head
When there's sadness leaves you broken in your bed
I will hold you in the dust of your despair
And it's all in the name of love, the name of love
